'''Striking Staff''' was a powerful [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Esh-kha]] warrior who was imprisoned on the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] thousands of years before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
He resided within [[the Tomb]] when he along with his kind were accidentally freed by the attack of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Tomb. This led to the Esh-kha attacking both the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During this time, he was part of an Esh-kha force occupying a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vault containing advanced stasis technology.<ref name="TOR" />

Imperial droid [[TA-350]] tasked an Imperial citizen with recovering the stasis technology. During recovery, Striking Staff was killed.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Striking Staff is a Champion-level enemy in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' who serves as the boss of the optional Breakthrough mission on Belsavis. This article assumes one hundred percent game completion, so he was killed.<ref name="TOR" />
